request.background: NEW change item: Viewers no longer receive an error: a viewer now exports only the records they own (record 'owner' equal to user['name']), in any project; every other rule still applies to those records.

items.text: CURRENT [S1.2, S4.2] Scope: a user whose role is 'admin' may export records of any project. Any other role exports only records whose 'project' is in user['projects']; other records are left out without an error. AMENDED by S4.2: Users whose role is neither 'admin' nor 'viewer' may now also export the records they own (record 'owner' equal to user['name']), even outside their projects.
CURRENT [S2.1] Viewers: if user['role'] is 'viewer', raise PermissionError; nothing is exported.
